stocks.name: ZCCM Investments Holdings Plc
stocks.description: Zambia's state-linked investment holding company with interests in copper, cobalt, gold, emeralds and energy assets, including minority stakes in major mining ventures on the Copperbelt and in North-Western Province.

stocks.name: Zambia National Commercial Bank Plc
stocks.description: One of Zambia's largest commercial banks by branch network and customer base, part-owned by Rabobank, offering retail, SME and corporate banking across all ten provinces.

stocks.name: Standard Chartered Bank Zambia Plc
stocks.description: The Zambian subsidiary of Standard Chartered PLC, focused on corporate and institutional banking, treasury services and premier retail banking.

stocks.name: Copperbelt Energy Corporation Plc
stocks.description: Transmits and distributes electric power to the Zambian Copperbelt mining region and supplies mines in the DRC, with growing renewables and gas-to-power investments through CEC Africa.

stocks.name: CEC Africa Investments Plc
stocks.description: Pan-African power investment vehicle spun off from CEC, developing generation and transmission assets across Zambia, Nigeria, Sierra Leone and Mozambique.

stocks.name: Airtel Networks Zambia Plc
stocks.description: Zambia's leading mobile network operator providing voice, data and mobile money (Airtel Money) services to over 9 million subscribers nationwide.

stocks.name: Zambia Sugar Plc
stocks.description: Sub-Saharan Africa's second largest sugar producer, operating the Nakambala estate in Mazabuka, part of the Illovo Sugar group, exporting across the SADC region and COMESA.

stocks.name: Zambeef Products Plc
stocks.description: One of Africa's largest agri-businesses, producing beef, chicken, pork, milk, eggs and row crops with an integrated retail chain (Shoprite counters) and Cold Chain logistics.

stocks.name: Puma Energy Zambia Plc
stocks.description: Fuel import, storage, distribution and retail business operating service stations nationwide and supplying mining, agricultural and transport sectors; majority owned by Puma Energy International.

stocks.name: Chilanga Cement Plc
stocks.description: Zambia's pioneer cement manufacturer operating the Chilanga and Ndola plants under the Lafarge brand, serving construction demand in Zambia and the DRC Copperbelt.

stocks.name: Dangote Cement Zambia Plc
stocks.description: Zambian arm of Africa's largest cement producer, operating a 1.5Mtpa integrated plant in Ndola with limestone deposits on site, exporting to the DRC and neighbouring markets.

stocks.name: Zambia Forestry & Forest Industries Plc
stocks.description: Commercial pine and eucalyptus plantation grower and timber processor based in the Copperbelt, one of the fastest-moving equities on the LuSE in recent seasons.

stocks.name: Bata Shoe Company Plc
stocks.description: Footwear manufacturer and retailer with a nationwide retail chain and the Bata factory in Chililabombwe, part of the global Bata Shoe Organization.

stocks.name: Real Estate Investments Zambia Plc
stocks.description: Property investment and development REIT owning prime commercial, industrial and residential assets including Acers Park in Lusaka and the Arcades shopping centre.

stocks.name: National Breweries Plc
stocks.description: Brewer of Chibuku Shake Shake and traditional sorghum-based opaque beers in Zambia, majority owned by Zambian Breweries (AB InBev group).

stocks.name: PZ Cussons Zambia Plc
stocks.description: Manufacturer and distributor of personal care, hygiene and household brands including Ushumba, Juvena and Imperial Leather for the Zambian market.

stocks.name: Shoprite Holdings Ltd (ZDR)
stocks.description: Zambian Depositary Receipts of Africa's largest food retailer, operating Shoprite and Usave supermarkets across Zambia with local supply chains and franchise support.
